name: RaportVisits
title: Calendar providers, clinical encounters and stored appointment links
description: Requires api:fhir and system/*.$raport-visits. Without parameters returns calendar-qualified providers (username set, authorized=1, calendar=1; inactive users included with active=false). With patient=<uuid> returns every appointment and clinical encounter of that patient. With start and end (inclusive clinic-local days, at most 31) returns every patient appointment dated in the window, every recurring series overlapping it, every clinical encounter dated in it, every encounter those appointments link even when it is dated outside the window, and every appointment currently linked to one of those encounters. An appointment link is the Flow Board tracker row matching the appointment's current patient, date, start time and id; a blank encounter is unlinked. Several appointments may link one encounter. One appointment linked to more than one encounter, or a link to a missing, duplicate or other-patient encounter, fails with 409. Recurring series are flagged, never expanded or linked. Dates and times are clinic-local wall clock without offsets. A record without a usable UUID or date fails with 409. complete=true means no row was omitted: any access denial fails the request with 403. Repeated query keys collapse to the last value before the module sees them.

parameter.name: end
parameter.documentation: Last clinic-local day, inclusive. At most 31 days counting both ends.

part.name: end
part.documentation: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS clinic-local wall clock: the date plus the stored end time, on the next day for an end of 24:00 or later. Absent without a stored end time.

part.name: status
part.documentation: The native FHIR Appointment status of a default pc_apptstatus: proposed, pending, booked, arrived, checked-in, fulfilled, cancelled, noshow or waitlist. Any other status fails with 409.

part.name: typeCode
part.documentation: Appointment category constant id, as native FHIR Appointment codes appointmentType.

part.name: location
part.documentation: Location UUID of the appointment facility, as native FHIR Appointment names it. Absent when the facility has none.
